title: Pankha Garmi Jaanta Nahi, Phir Bhi Tez Hota Hai #shorts
description:
Kamra garam hote hi pankha khud tez kyun ghoomta hai? Jawab ek chhote DHT11 sensor mein hai.
🌡️ DHT11 ke andar humidity layer aur thermistor
💧 Bhaap lagte hi resistance kaise badalta hai
🔌 Ek data wire se Arduino tak numbers
⚡ Pankha MOSFET se kyun chalta hai
Aise aur 3D explainers ke liye subscribe karo!
#shorts #arduino #dht11 #electronics #diyprojects #hindi
